reply.text:
For most beginners, about 2 to 3 sets per exercise is plenty, and 3 sets of 8 to 10 reps is a solid default. Pick a weight that leaves you 2 to 3 reps in the tank, since the goal early on is learning the movement and building a habit, not grinding.

Across a week, roughly 8 to 12 hard sets per muscle group is a good range to grow from. Start at the low end and add sets only when the current amount feels easy for a couple of weeks. More isn't better until your recovery shows you can handle it.

If you want, I can build you a program and the app will set the sets and reps for you.
